$comment: The scene bank — concrete reader-week moments for check 4 (Scene). copy.mdx names the structural gap this fills: 'product docs contain no Thursdays'; these are the Thursdays. Consumed by scenesFor() in the draft-prompt mirror pair (src/lib/draft-prompt.ts ⇄ scripts/lib/draft-prompt.mjs) for the Gemini lanes, and by the claude drain via .claude/skills/draft/references/scene-bank.md. Rules for entries: Arabic-first, nouns the reader touches (الورق، الكشف، الطابور), ONE moment per line, and NO digits or spelled-out figures — a number here would seed copy the craft gate's invented-number rule then refuses. Season windows are month-based for the Sudan slice (school year ≈ June→April; certificate exams mid-April — Apr 13-23 in 2026; Ramadan ≈ Feb-Mar through 2027). Refresh ritual: quarterly or at a season boundary, via a research session — verify the exam and Ramadan windows still hold, retire scenes reviewers stopped recognizing, add what the last term surfaced.
